# Get-ZbxHaNode

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the nodes of the server's high-availability cluster.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxHaNode [-Name <string>] [-Address <string>] [-Status <ZabbixHaNodeStatus>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxHaNode [-Id] <string[]> [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxHaNode cmdlet reads the server's high-availability nodes with hanode.get: each node's name, address, port, status (Active, Standby, Stopped or Unavailable) and when it was last seen. It writes all nodes, the nodes with the ids in -Id, or the nodes whose -Name, -Address and -Status match exactly; hanode.get has no search, so there are no wildcards. A server that does not run in a cluster reports one node with an empty name.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the cluster's nodes

```powershell
Get-ZbxHaNode | Select-Object Name, Address, Port, Status
```

LastAccess is the Unix time the node last updated its status.

### Example 2: Find the active node

```powershell
Get-ZbxHaNode -Status Active | Select-Object Name, Address, Port
```

-Status matches exactly; the active node is the one serving the frontend and the trappers.
